tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the predominant/primary theme — not pure black, a very dark neutral with a faint blue/teal cast for depth.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, anything raised off the page.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and control outlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-page / surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper copy.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: THE brand/identity color — the λ, proprietary marks, identity highlights. Primary hue of the system. Must not be displaced by accent (blue) as the 'main' color.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Functional/interactive color only — links, actions, interactive states, informational UI. Secondary to accent-teal; never used for identity elements (the symbol, the wordmark).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icons on a solid accent-teal or accent fill. Fixed dark value in BOTH themes — white-on-teal in light mode failed contrast, so this no longer flips with the theme.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background for badges, hovers, selected rows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline on interactive elements. Alias of accent (functional, not brand).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running paragraph copy. Provisional: a complementary editorial face for long-form text is an open decision (see README) — for now body copy also runs in JetBrains Mono.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows / all-caps labels, e.g. section kickers.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Secondary signature ("Always in pursuit of excellence.") set below the lockup in the Home hero, in ink-muted. Never replaces the lockup and is never used as a slogan or section title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gaps — icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact internal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default control padding, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Block spacing between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, feature blocks.

pattern.note: Dot-grid background of the Home hero. Dark theme only. Values reproduced from the approved Home mockup by measurement: the pitch is approximated (about 27.7px measured, 28px adopted).

tokens.name: dot-grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between dot centres, horizontally and vertically.

tokens.name: dot-grid-dot
tokens.usage: Radius of the solid part of each dot.

tokens.name: dot-grid-edge
tokens.usage: Radius at which each dot fades to fully transparent (soft edge).

tokens.name: dot-grid-color
tokens.usage: The ink token (#e7f1f2, dark) at 14% alpha. Keep the RGB in sync with ink: a pattern value cannot reference a colour token.
